description: Synthetic care_home_v1 scenario (all synthetic, 2026-01-16/17, America/New_York -05:00): an older adult lives alone in a modern single-storey house (demo-house); on a winter night the furnace stops and the thermostat stops reporting (outage 01:30-04:20); an independent room sensor shows the living area cooling; ARIA Home flags it before the household warm-by time 07:00; the resident and an adult-child family caregiver are notified; the caregiver authorises a simulated HVAC request; a technician visit and completion report follow (corroboration only); thermostat reporting returns (proves nothing alone); independent readings show warming and hold the 68 F goal, verified before the warm-by time. Sources: calendar, thermostat, room_sensor, electrical, weather, simulated events. Cadences: thermostat 300 s, room_sensor 300 s, electrical 1800 s, weather 21600 s. No health data, no medical terms, no location tracking of the person, no fall or activity sensing. Not a medical or emergency service.
